title: 7 Day Western National Parks Tour, Las Vegas to San Francisco via Grand Canyon
includes: All camping equipment provided (if camping option selected).
Live commentary is provided in English.
National park entry fees (excludes additional non US resident government fees if applicable)
App with tour commentary in French, German, Spanish, Italian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children under 17 years must be accompanied by an adult.

Camping accommodation is a solo or 2-person tent. If you are traveling as a couple or as a group of four or more, please advise this at the time of booking in the Special Requirements box so accommodations can be made to keep your party together.

Lodging accommodation is a 2-person room shared by same-sex travelers or on a couple basis. If your party is 3 or 5 guests, you will be in 1 or 2 triples rooms with two queen beds in each. All lodging accommodations are of 3 star quality or higher.
Campsites used are typically equipped with Wi-Fi, laundry and hot showers, and some may have outdoor hot tubs and swimming pools.
Vegetarian meals are available upon request.
Minimum age is 7 years old to take this tour.
New Tour Option- Purchase 8 seats and have a fully private tour with selected ticket type.
All camping equipment-fully sanitized between tours.
Please Note: National Park fees may apply for international visitors. If applicable, this fee is collected in-destination and not at the time of booking.
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel between 2 and 6 day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a 50% refund.
If you cancel within 2 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb:
This is an incredible 7 day adventure with an opportunity to see so many of America's National Parks and Native Lands. You will enjoy Zion, Bryce, Antelope Canyon, Monument Valley, Grand Canyon as well as Death Valley and Yosemite. This is truly a trip that you will remember forever.

Tour Highlights

Camp under starry skies with camping ticket type
Retire to a cozy hotel room in prime locations with hotel ticket type
Spectacular national parks walks & hikes for every fitness level
Grand Canyon sunset
Expert tour guide throughout with entertaining stories, history, flora and fauna who knows the best locations for optimal exploration of the parks
Navajo guided Monument Valley 4X4 jeep tour included
Spectacular photography inside of Antelope Canyon (if option selected)
Leisurely stroll along the Grand Canyon South Rim
Explore Death Valley
Yosemite walks and hikes with your expert tour guide

New Tour Option- Purchase 8 seats and have a fully private tour with selected ticket type.
